cases.name: required String reserves one item before constructor execution

steps.source: let calls=0;class C{constructor(v:any){calls++;}}type T=[...[].<C>,...[1].<string>,...[].<boolean>];const raw:any=[1,"s"];const t:T=raw;const x:any=t;calls+"/"+String(x is T)+"/"+x[1]+"/"+String(x===raw);

cases.name: explicit tuple cast uses the same selected constructor

steps.source: let calls=0;class C{constructor(v:any){calls++;}}type T=[...[].<C>,...[1].<string>,...[].<boolean>];const raw:any=[1,"s"];const x:any=raw:=T;calls+"/"+String(x is T);

cases.name: whole membership wins over converting constructors

steps.source: let calls=0;class C{constructor(v:any){calls++;}}type T=[...[].<C>,...[1].<string>,...[].<boolean>];const raw:any=["s",true];const t:T=raw;const x:any=t;calls+"/"+String(x===raw)+"/"+String(x is T);

steps.source: let log="";class C{constructor(v:uint8){log+=String(v is uint8);}}type T=[...[].<C>,...[1].<string>,...[].<boolean>];const raw:any=[7,"s"];const t:T=raw;const x:any=t;log+"/"+String(x is T);

steps.source: let calls=0;class C{constructor(v:uint8){calls++;}}type T=[...[].<C>,...[].<string>];const raw:any=[257,"s"];const t:T=raw;const x:any=t;calls+"/"+String(x is T)+"/"+x[0];

cases.name: no viable assignment retains checked parameter range failure

steps.source: let calls=0;class C{constructor(v:uint8){calls++;}}type T=[...[1].<C>,...[].<string>,...[].<boolean>];let e="";try{const raw:any=[257,"s"];const t:T=raw;}catch(x){e=x.name;}e+"/"+calls;

cases.name: explicit tuple cast does not wrap a constructor argument

steps.source: let calls=0;class C{constructor(v:uint8){calls++;}}type T=[...[1].<C>,...[].<string>,...[].<boolean>];let e="";try{const raw:any=[257,"s"];const t=raw:=T;}catch(x){e=x.name;}e+"/"+calls;

cases.name: constructor effects occur once in index order

steps.source: let log="";class C{constructor(v:any){log+=String(v);}}type T=[...[].<C>,...[1].<string>,...[].<boolean>];const raw:any=[1,2,"s"];const t:T=raw;const x:any=t;log+"/"+String(x is T);

cases.name: selected constructor failure does not try another class

steps.source: let log="";class C{constructor(v:any){log+="c";throw new RangeError("selected");}}class D{constructor(v:any){log+="d";}}type T=[...[].<C>,...[].<D>,...[1].<string>];let e="";try{const raw:any=[1,"s"];const t:T=raw;}catch(x){e=x.name;}e+"/"+log;

cases.name: wrong constructor result is refused without retry

steps.source: let log="";class C{constructor(v:any){log+="c";return {};}}class D{constructor(v:any){log+="d";}}type T=[...[].<C>,...[].<D>,...[1].<string>];let e="";try{const raw:any=[1,"s"];const t:T=raw;}catch(x){e=x.name;}e+"/"+log;

cases.name: unused constructors are not speculatively executed

steps.source: let log="";class C{constructor(v:any){log+="c";}}class D{constructor(v:any){log+="d";throw new Error("unused");}}type T=[...[].<C>,...[].<D>,...[1].<string>];const raw:any=[1,"s"];const t:T=raw;const x:any=t;log+"/"+String(x is T);

cases.name: all retained source Gets precede selected constructors

steps.source: let log="";class C{constructor(v:any){log+="c"+v;}}type T=[...[].<C>,...[1].<string>,...[].<boolean>];const raw:any=[1,"s"];Object.defineProperty(raw,"0",{get(){log+="g0";return 1;}});Object.defineProperty(raw,"1",{get(){log+="g1";return "s";}});const t:T=raw;const x:any=t;log+"/"+String(x is T);

cases.name: required count failure runs no constructor

steps.source: let calls=0;class C{constructor(v:any){calls++;}}type T=[...[].<C>,...[1].<string>,...[].<boolean>];let e="";try{const raw:any=[];const t:T=raw;}catch(x){e=x.name;}e+"/"+calls;

cases.name: zero nominal run never invokes its constructor

steps.source: let calls=0;class C{constructor(v:any){calls++;}}type T=[...[0].<C>,...[].<string>,...[].<boolean>];const raw:any=[1];const t:T=raw;const x:any=t;calls+"/"+String(x is T)+"/"+x[0];

cases.name: nested tuple spread retains the required count

steps.source: let calls=0;class C{constructor(v:any){calls++;}}type Inner=[...[].<C>,...[1].<string>];type T=[...Inner,...[].<boolean>];const raw:any=[1,"s"];const t:T=raw;const x:any=t;calls+"/"+String(x is T);

cases.name: fresh converted owner refuses an invalid later ordering

steps.source: class C{constructor(v:any){}}type T=[...[].<C>,...[1].<string>,...[].<boolean>];const raw:any=[1,"s"];const t:T=raw;const x:any=t;let e="";try{x[1]=new C(2);}catch(err){e=err.name;}e+"/"+String(x is T)+"/"+x[1];

cases.name: fresh converted owner guards a retained unconverted child

steps.source: class D{}class C{constructor(v:any){}}type T=[...[].<D>,...[].<C>,...[1].<string>];const child:any=new D();const raw:any=[child,1,"s"];const t:T=raw;const x:any=t;String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(child,null))+"/"+String(x is T);

cases.name: removal releases only the correlated retained child

steps.source: class D{}class C{constructor(v:any){}}type T=[...[].<D>,...[].<C>,...[].<string>];const child:any=new D();const raw:any=[child,1,"s"];const t:T=raw;const x:any=t;x.shift();String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(child,null))+"/"+String(x is T);

cases.name: completed selected C conversion keeps its exact obligation

steps.source: let saved:any;class C{constructor(v:any){saved=this;}}type T=[...[].<C>,...[].<string>];const raw:any=[1,"s"];const t:T=raw;const x:any=t;x.pop();String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(saved,null))+"/"+String(x is T);

cases.name: later constructor effects invalidate a retained earlier role

steps.source: let child:any;let calls=0;class D{}class C{constructor(v:any){calls++;Object.setPrototypeOf(child,null);}}type T=[...[].<D>,...[].<C>,...[1].<string>];child=new D();let e="";try{const raw:any=[child,1,"s"];const t:T=raw;}catch(x){e=x.name;}e+"/"+calls+"/"+String(Object.getPrototypeOf(child)===null);

cases.name: earlier exact conversion survives later selected failure

steps.source: let saved:any;let calls=0;class C{constructor(v:any){calls++;if(v===2)throw new Error("later");saved=this;}}type T=[...[].<C>,...[1].<string>,...[].<boolean>];let e="";try{const raw:any=[1,2,"s"];const t:T=raw;}catch(x){e=x.name;}e+"/"+calls+"/"+String(Reflect.setPrototypeOf(saved,null));

cases.name: indexed replacement uses selected nominal conversion

steps.source: let calls=0;class C{constructor(v:any){calls++;}}type T=[...[].<C>,...[1].<string>,...[].<boolean>];const raw:any=[new C(0),"s"];const t:T=raw;calls=0;raw[0]=1;calls+"/"+String(raw is T)+"/"+String(raw[0] is C);

cases.name: insertion respects existing position contracts before construction

steps.source: let calls=0;class C{constructor(v:any){calls++;}}type T=[...[].<C>,...[1].<string>,...[].<boolean>];const raw:any=["s"];const t:T=raw;let e="";try{raw.unshift(1);}catch(x){e=x.name;}e+"/"+calls+"/"+String(raw is T)+"/"+raw.length;

cases.name: reflective writes execute a selected nominal conversion

steps.source: let calls=0;class C{constructor(v:any){calls++;}}type T=[...[].<C>,...[1].<string>,...[].<boolean>];const raw:any=[new C(0),"s"];const t:T=raw;calls=0;let e="";try{Object.defineProperty(raw,"0",{value:1});}catch(x){e=x.name;}e+"/"+calls+"/"+String(raw is T);

cases.name: constructor mutation of the destination is retained but outer store fails

steps.source: let raw:any;let calls=0;class C{constructor(v:any){calls++;if(v===1)raw[1]="changed";}}type T=[...[].<C>,...[1].<string>,...[].<boolean>];raw=[new C(0),"s"];const t:T=raw;calls=0;let e="";try{raw[0]=1;}catch(x){e=x.name;}e+"/"+calls+"/"+raw[1]+"/"+String(raw is T);

cases.name: type alias parameter uses class declaration context

steps.source: let calls=0;type P=uint8;class C{constructor(v:P){calls++;}}type T=[...[].<C>,...[1].<string>,...[].<boolean>];function go(){type P=boolean;const raw:any=[1,"s"];const t:T=raw;const x:any=t;return String(x is T);}const answer=go();calls+"/"+answer;

cases.name: narrow reference still refuses a projected nominal position

steps.source: class C{constructor(v:any){}}type T=[...[].<C>,...[1].<string>,...[].<boolean>];const raw:any=[1,"s"];const t:T=raw;const x:any=t;let entered=false;function take(ref v:C){entered=true;}let e="";try{take(ref x[0]);}catch(err){e=err.name;}e+"/"+String(entered)+"/"+String(x is T);

cases.name: constructor is preferred over the source conversion operator

steps.source: let log="";class C{constructor(v:any){log+="c";}}class S{operator C(){log+="s";return new C(0);}}type T=[...[].<C>,...[1].<string>,...[].<boolean>];const raw:any=[new S(),"s"];const t:T=raw;const x:any=t;log+"/"+String(x is T);
